关键词: World Car Design Of The Year
主要内容: The Jaguar I-PACE was named the 2019 World Car Design of the Year, joining the Suzuki Jimny and the Volvo XC40 in the awards. The awards were decided by an international jury of 86 automotive journalists from 24 countries. The World Car Steering Committee appointed the jurors based on their expertise, experience, credibility, and influence. KPMG tabulated the ballots. The awards journey included events like the L.A. Test Drives and the Consumer Electronics Show (CES), where discussions on automotive and consumer tech were held. The Global Trends Report, co-presented by Prime Research and Autoneum, was announced during the New York International Auto Show. Autoneum CEO Martin Hirzel highlighted the report's role in identifying future industry trends, particularly electric mobility, and emphasized the company's contributions to vehicle comfort and safety through its technologies. The awards ceremony concluded with a press conference in Paris on April 17, 2019, marking the end of the annual journey that began in October 2018 in Paris. The event's photos and videos were made available on the World Car Awards website. The awards are now in their 15th year and remain the top automotive awards globally based on Prime Research's 2018 media report.
